responsibility: Implements the main lowering logic from Rust HIR expressions and statements into BIR for borrow checking. This file owns the concrete visitor bodies that translate control flow, assignments, borrows, dereferences, calls, literals, struct construction, loops, if/else forms, let bindings, and expression statements into BIR places, assignments, temporaries, scopes, and basic-block edges, while delegating specialized cases such as short-circuit booleans, patterns, and struct field collection to neighboring helper builders.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line implementation of ExprStmtBuilder for the borrowck subdirectory, with the concrete HIR visitor bodies that lower executable expressions and statements into BIR and coordinate helper builders such as lazy-boolean, pattern, and struct lowering; unlike the matching header, it contains the actual translation logic and CFG/place construction.
